summary: kaytus.ksmanage adds upload_ssl, ssl_info and generate_ssl modules, renames its SDK, changes a URL path on owner change, and updates log, network bond and SNMP module attributes.
questions: How do I upload an SSL certificate with kaytus.ksmanage?
Which new modules are in kaytus.ksmanage?

answer_card.title: kaytus.ksmanage changes
answer_card.answer_md:
- New modules: **`upload_ssl`**, **`ssl_info`**, **`generate_ssl`**.
- The SDK used was renamed.
- URL path changed when the owner changes.
- `edit_m6_log_setting` adds `server_status`; `edit_network_bond` descriptions updated; `edit_snmp`/`edit_snmp_trap` changed allowed `auth_protocol` and `priv_protocol` values.
